title: Timbaland launches AI music company Stage Zero, with first AI artist, TaTa (MBW)
notes: MBW 2025-06-09. Stage Zero (Timbaland + Rocky Mudaliar + Zayd Portillo) operates separately from Suno but its music 'relies on a collaborative process with Suno' — Timbaland uploads demos, Suno processes them + human lyrics. TaTa's voice originated from a Suno generation (a Suno Persona). So Stage Zero USES Suno (third-party model); it does not make its own music model. Corroborated by Rolling Stone (137) + NPR.
